ifYou: Haddii ay adiga ahayd, waxba uma baahnid inaad samayso.
secureHelp: Badhanku wuxuu furaa bog aad ku dooran karto furaha sirta ah oo cusub. Intaas ka dib, fur Vaultara, tag Bogga shakhsiga > Amniga iyo asturnaanta > Qalabkaaga oo taabo Ka bax dhammaan qalabka kale.
support: Ka jawaab iimaylkan ama la xiriir {supportEmail}.
securityFooter: Waxaan kuu soo dirnaa iimaylkan si aan u ilaalino akoonkaaga Vaultara. Iimaylladan ma demin kartid.
billingFooter: Waxaan kuu soo dirnaa iimaylkan si aad had iyo jeer u ogaato waxa ka socda isdiiwaangelintaada Vaultara.
newSignInSubject: Gelitaan cusub oo akoonkaaga Vaultara ah
newSignInBody: Hadda ayaa akoonkaaga Vaultara laga soo galay qalab aanan hore u arag.
passwordChangedSubject: Furahaaga sirta ah ee Vaultara waa la beddelay
passwordChangedHeading: Furaha sirta ah waa la beddelay
passwordChangedBody: Furaha sirta ah ee akoonkaaga Vaultara hadda ayaa la beddelay.
emailChangeRequestedBody: Waxaa la sameeyay codsi lagu beddelayo iimaylka akoonkaaga.
emailChangeRequestedBodyTo: Waxaa la sameeyay codsi lagu beddelayo iimaylka akoonkaaga oo laga dhigayo {maskedNewEmail}.
twoStepDisabledSubject: Gelitaanka laba tallaabo ah waa la demiyay
twoStepDisabledHeading: Gelitaanka laba tallaabo ah waa la demiyay
twoStepDisabledBody: Gelitaanka laba tallaabo ah hadda ayaa laga demiyay akoonkaaga Vaultara. Hadda gelitaanku wuxuu u baahan yahay furahaaga sirta ah oo keliya.
sessionsRevokedHeading: Waa lagaa saaray meel kasta oo kale
sessionsRevokedBody: Akoonkaaga Vaultara hadda ayaa laga saaray dhammaan qalabka marka laga reebo kii loo isticmaalay isbeddelkan.
includedPremium: Premium waxaa ku jira diiwaanno iyo qaybo aan xad lahayn, sawirro lagu lifaaqo, link-yo wadaag ah iyo xusuusiyeyaal horumarsan.
includedFamily: Family waxaa ku jira wax kasta oo Premium ah, oo ay weheliyaan diiwaanno iyo xusuusiyeyaal la wadaago oo loogu talagalay gurigaaga oo dhan.
includedBusiness: Business waxaa ku jira wax kasta oo Family ah, oo ay weheliyaan xusuusiyeyaal shaqaalaha, codsiyo cusboonaysiin iyo warbixinno u hoggaansanaanta.
receiptGoogle: Google Play ayaa kuu soo dira rasiidkaaga rasmiga ah oo leh lacagta lagaa jaray.
receiptApple: Apple ayaa kuu soo dira rasiidkaaga rasmiga ah oo leh lacagta lagaa jaray.
startedBody: Waad ku mahadsan tahay isdiiwaangelinta. Qorshahaaga {plan} hadda waa shaqaynayaa.
renewedBody: Qorshahaaga {plan} waa la cusboonaysiiyay. Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad la sii joogto Vaultara.
yearlyReminderSubject: Qorshahaaga Vaultara {plan} waxaa la cusboonaysiinayaa 7 maalmood kadib
yearlyReminderBody: Qorshahaaga sannadlaha ah ee {plan} waxaa la cusboonaysiinayaa {date}. Haddii aad rabto inaad haysato, waxba uma baahnid inaad samayso. Haddii aad rabto inaad beddesho ama joojiso, waxaad taas samayn kartaa ka hor taariikhda cusboonaysiinta.
cancelledHeading: Cusboonaysiinta tooska ah waa la demiyay
cancelledBody: Cusboonaysiinta tooska ah hadda waa ka dansan tahay qorshahaaga {plan}. Waxaad haysan doontaa helitaan buuxa ilaa {date}. Intaas ka dib, akoonkaagu wuxuu u guurayaa qorshaha Bilaash, diiwaannadaaduna way ammaan ahaanayaan.
resumedSubject: Qorshahaaga Vaultara {plan} mar kale ayaa la cusboonaysiin doonaa
resumedHeading: Cusboonaysiinta tooska ah waa la shiday
resumedBody: Cusboonaysiinta tooska ah mar kale ayay ku shidan tahay qorshahaaga {plan}. Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad la sii joogto Vaultara.
endedBody: Qorshahaaga {plan} wuu dhammaaday, akoonkaaguna hadda wuxuu ku jiraa qorshaha Bilaash. Diiwaannadaadu weli waxay ku jiraan akoonkaaga. Waxaad mar kale isdiiwaangelin kartaa wakhti kasta adigoo isticmaalaya app-ka.
refundedSubject: Lacagta iibsiga Vaultara {plan} waa laguu celiyay
refundedBody: Lacagta iibsiga qorshahaaga {plan} waa laguu celiyay. Helitaankii la socday iibsigan wuu dhammaaday.
deleteBody: Waxaan helnay codsi lagu tirtirayo akoonka Vaultara ee isticmaala cinwaankan iimaylka. Si aad u sii wadato, fur link-ga hoose. Waxaad dib u eegi kartaa waxa la tirtiri doono ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.
deleteExpiry: Link-gu hal mar ayuu shaqeeyaa wuxuuna dhacayaa 1 saac kadib.
deleteNotYou: Haddii aadan tan codsan, iska indha tir iimaylkan. Akoonkaagu sidiisa ayuu ahaanayaa.
deleteFooter: Waxaan kuu soo dirnay iimaylkan sababtoo ah qof ayaa codsaday in la tirtiro akoonka Vaultara ee cinwaankan.
